blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has formally turned over the chairmanship of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) to Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong, marking a new leadership for the regional intergovernmental organization in 2027.
